move: grid of plus signs quarter-turn in a checkerboard with a diagonal ripple
how: A 10x6 grid of 64px plus-shaped crosses, near-black with every fourth diagonal in orange, on warm off-white. Each cross rotates 0 to 90deg with expo.inOut over 0.55s, neighbours turning opposite ways, delayed up to 0.35s by diagonal distance so the turn ripples from top-left; because a cross is fourfold symmetric the end state equals the start. During the turn each cross dips scale 1 to 0.8 and back with sine.inOut yoyo. The full cycle is 1s.
adapt: Change the ink and accent colours and background, the grid size, the cross arm thickness, or replace the cross with any fourfold-symmetric glyph. Keep the 90deg turn and the diagonal delay so the loop stays clean.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the grid and cross elements; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline of rotation and scale tweens with delays as fractions of D. Nothing depends on viewport size beyond the grid filling el.
